rows.check: The diff is four files: .claude/hooks/graphify-common.sh, graphify-provision.sh, graphify-refresh.sh and the new .claude/hooks/tests/graphify-out-path.test.mjs. `git diff --name-only origin/chore/config-drift...HEAD` lists no file under .claude/lib/superpowers-parallel/, so workflow-sandbox.mjs and its vm realm construction are untouched; no realm global is created or reassigned here.

No sandbox denial mechanism is edited. The only new failure paths are shell returns: graphify_out returns 1 on an empty root at .claude/hooks/graphify-common.sh:33, graphify_config_dir returns 1 on an unresolvable config dir at :26-27, and graphify_launch returns 1 on a missing argument at :53. These are bash exit statuses in a hook process, not host errors raised inside a workflow realm.

No guarded intrinsic and no member enumeration is touched; the diff adds no JavaScript to the engine, only bash in .claude/hooks/ and a node:test file under .claude/hooks/tests/ that spawns bash and asserts on stdout.

VALUE_GLOBALS, ALWAYS_DENIED and ALLOWED_GLOBALS are not referenced by this diff. The one constant it introduces, GRAPHIFY_OUT_NAME at .claude/hooks/graphify-common.sh:3, is load-bearing on both of its uses: emptying it breaks the fallback at :48 and the refresh prune at .claude/hooks/graphify-refresh.sh:16, and the base-version run of the new test file showed 10 of 11 assertions red once the function was absent.

The identifier census lives in the sandbox test suite and is not extended or narrowed here. The new test file asserts output-path strings returned by graphify_out and the environment of the launched child, so it adds no bare identifier in workflow-body position and removes no census row.

The harness and its production caller are untouched. By the same liveness standard, the new graphify_out is not a lint-only artifact: it has two production callers, .claude/hooks/graphify-provision.sh:8 and .claude/hooks/graphify-refresh.sh:8, both of which are registered hooks at .claude/settings.json:105 and :139.

This file is the committed coverage artifact for the unit and carries a row for all 17 registry ids read from docs/invariants/registry.json. The verdicts live here, not in the PR body; the PR body will carry only the Why/What/Verification fields the pr-create tool composes.

graphify_out classifies a scan root by path and the classification is total, not sampled: the config-tree case at .claude/hooks/graphify-common.sh:44-46 matches "$config" or "$config"/* and every other root falls through to :48, while the unclassifiable input (an empty root) halts with return 1 at :33. The refresh prune at .claude/hooks/graphify-refresh.sh:16 excludes by the whole path segment named in GRAPHIFY_OUT_NAME rather than by a pinned list of known output trees.

.claude/hooks/tests/graphify-out-path.test.mjs asserts the reported symptom (output landing under a config subtree) at its config-subtree case and at the launch case, which checks that no graphify-out appears under the hooks root. Restoring the parent file with `git checkout HEAD -- .claude/hooks/graphify-common.sh` and re-running gave 11 tests, 1 pass, 10 fail; with the change restored, 11 pass, 0 fail. That parent-file restore is also the inertness mutation: removing graphify_out returns the old $root/graphify-out behavior and turns the assertions red.

Commit fea9493 carries both a structural change and a behavior change in one reviewable range: graphify_launch's third parameter becomes the output dir and the lock is derived inside it at .claude/hooks/graphify-common.sh:52-54, alongside the behavioral relocation at :44-46 and the GRAPHIFY_OUT export at :66. No characterization test predated the refactor; the test file was written in the same commit. Mitigation, not a cure: that file pins both the surviving per-project behavior and the new config-tree behavior, and was 10-of-11 red on the parent file.

Every path:line anchor in this record was re-derived after the final edit with `grep -n` over the worktree copies of .claude/hooks/graphify-common.sh, graphify-provision.sh and graphify-refresh.sh, and with `grep -n graphify .claude/settings.json` for the :105 and :139 hook registrations, each re-checked at the ship stage against the file rather than carried over. None was copied from another coverage record or from the unit brief.

All three edited hooks are deployed as symlinks into the tracked checkout: `ls -l ~/.claude/hooks/graphify-*.sh` shows graphify-common.sh, graphify-provision.sh and graphify-refresh.sh each resolving to .windful-ocean/.claude/hooks/, so the deployed guard is reproduced from committed source at this SHA with no install step. Nothing was hand-patched in the deployed tree: the edits and the two verification rewrites landed on the worktree copies under .claude/worktrees/wf_f539b84e-78f-4/ only.

No merge command is added or enabled. The diff contains no gh, gh api or GraphQL invocation, and .claude/hooks/block-destructive-bash.sh is not in `git diff --name-only origin/chore/config-drift...HEAD`; the only command the changed code runs is `graphify update` at .claude/hooks/graphify-common.sh:66.

No pull request is created or edited by this unit; per the unit brief the ship stage opens it. Nothing in the diff touches .claude/lib/git/pr.mjs or the deny list in .claude/hooks/block-destructive-bash.sh that forbids a post-creation title or body rewrite.
The centralized creation path is untouched: pr.mjs, its tests under .claude/lib/git/tests/ and the bash gate are all outside this diff, and this unit issues no PR-creating command at all.

This diff edits three hook files but weakens no protection of them: block-destructive-bash.sh and protect-claude-config.sh are unchanged, and no guardrail file is removed or relocated. Stated plainly because it is adjacent: verifying the red state overwrote the worktree copy of graphify-common.sh twice from bash, once with `git checkout HEAD --` and once with `cp` from the scratchpad; both targeted .claude/worktrees/wf_f539b84e-78f-4/, and the deployed symlink target in the main checkout was never written.

No named network command is introduced. graphify_launch runs the local `graphify update` binary at .claude/hooks/graphify-common.sh:66 with the scan root as its only argument; the added GRAPHIFY_OUT="$out" is an environment assignment on that local command, carries an output directory rather than a credential or guardrail path, and reaches no network.
